description: This source file implements client cache management functions for WiFi clients, including allocation, retrieval, sample collection, calculation of client statistics, and cache cleanup. It primarily handles data structures representing WiFi clients, their connection statistics, and associated functions to manipulate these structures in the context of WiFi management.

methods.name: bool is_client_alive(sm_client_t * client)
methods.description: Checks if a client is considered alive by verifying the 'is_updated' flag and the last sample's connection status.

methods.name: int client_id_get(const mac_address_t mac,const unsigned int vap_index,sm_client_id_t id)
methods.description: Generates a unique client ID string based on MAC address and vap index.

methods.name: sm_client_t * client_alloc(sm_client_cache_t * cache,sm_client_id_t client_id)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new client structure, inserting it into the cache hash map.

methods.name: sm_client_t * client_get_or_alloc(sm_client_cache_t * cache,sm_client_id_t client_id)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing client from cache or allocates a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: void client_samples_free(ds_dlist_t * samples,free_samples_type type)
methods.description: Frees samples in a list, either all or all except the last one based on the specified type.

methods.name: int client_hal_to_sample(unsigned int radio_index,ssid_t ssid,if_name_t ifname,wifi_associated_dev3_t * dev3,sm_client_conn_t * conn_info,dpp_client_record_t * result)
methods.description: Converts a hardware representation of a client (dev3) into a sample record, filling in various statistics and metadata.

methods.name: int client_sample_add(sm_client_cache_t * cache,unsigned int radio_index,unsigned int vap_index,ssid_t ssid,if_name_t ifname,wifi_associated_dev3_t * dev3,sm_client_conn_t * conn_info)
methods.description: Creates and adds a sample record for a client, inserting it into the client's sample list.

methods.name: int sm_client_samples_calc_total(ds_dlist_t * samples,dpp_client_record_t * result)
methods.description: Calculates total statistics for a client's samples, averaging where applicable and considering connection states.

methods.name: int sm_client_sample_store(unsigned int radio_index,unsigned int vap_index,wifi_associated_dev3_t * dev3,sm_client_conn_t * conn_info)
methods.description: Stores a new client sample into the cache, handling SSID, interface name, and client data.

methods.name: void sm_client_cache_free(sm_client_cache_t * cache)
methods.description: Frees all client samples and removes clients that are no longer alive from the cache.

methods.name: void sm_client_cache_init(sm_client_cache_t * cache)
methods.description: Initializes the client cache by creating the hash map.

methods.name: void sm_client_cache_deinit(sm_client_cache_t * cache)
methods.description: Deinitializes the client cache by freeing resources and destroying the hash map.
